evals.prompt: 我这堆任务乱死了，帮我分个优先级，有些其实我也不知道还要不要做
evals.expected_output: Tasks triaged into now/next/someday-maybe with a reason each; unclear items land in someday/maybe rather than being forced into yes/no; no fabricated urgency.

evals.prompt: Sort my task list before the week starts — everything feels urgent
evals.expected_output: A triaged list where the everything-is-urgent pattern is broken by explicit criteria; items triaged twice with different outcomes get flagged as under-specified.

evals.prompt: 整理一下我 GitHub 上攒的 issue 和我自己的待办
